create_solar_open_config: create a SolarOpenConfig instance with custom model parameters for the SolarOpen language model
build_solar_open_model: build a SolarOpenModel using Glm4MoeModel as the base architecture with custom MoE configuration
run_solar_open_causal_lm: run SolarOpenForCausalLM for autoregressive text generation with 100B parameter support
configure_solar_open_moe: configure SolarOpenMoE with 8 experts per token and 1280 intermediate size for mixture-of-experts inference
setup_solar_open_attention: setup SolarOpenAttention with 64 attention heads, 128 head dim, and custom o_proj projection layer
